actions.action: Prepare the scope recommendation, evidence package, decision packets, correction review, pilot and this checklist
Provision the external trust store with public keys for every role this scope needs; set REVFORGE_APPROVAL_TRUST_STORE or approval.trust_store
actions.evidence: organizational identity verification of each signer

actions.action: Optional pilot: review and sign the source-export authorization for the prepared cases, then the operator imports it
actions.evidence: pilot authorization request (files, hashes, model, limits, expiry)

actions.action: Optional pilot: run LIVE review and compare on the authorized cases; route advisory records to the review queue
actions.evidence: signed authorization, API key, network enabled by the operator

actions.action: Review the citation correction proposals; if correct, sign the item review decision (resolved_requires_update, selected_option = proposal) and apply the correction
actions.evidence: correction review: original vs proposed line text, hashes, re-derivation
actions.output: signed resolution, then workflow correct --kind citation_line
actions.verified_by: workflow decisions list (resolved) and a new COR record

actions.action: Confirm the technical facts established from source (class A) and sign the corresponding review decisions
actions.evidence: decision packets class A (deterministic checks and excerpts)
actions.verified_by: workflow decisions resolve; workflow g2 evaluate --scope

actions.action: Decide the technical / architecture questions (class D)
Confirm, correct or exclude the interpretations that need independent review and business judgment (classes B and C), using the pilot results only as advisory input
actions.evidence: decision packets classes B/C; optional advisory pilot records

actions.action: Supply or account for missing source / runtime dependencies (class E)
actions.output: source added read-only and the reverse/forward steps re-run, or a signed resolution

actions.action: Re-evaluate the scope after the signed actions; if deliverables changed, re-run consolidation and verification first
actions.output: scope READY or the remaining blockers

actions.action: Export the approval request for the READY scope
actions.output: AREQ-NNNN with the exact scope digest

actions.action: Review the request and sign the approval statement; the operator imports it
actions.evidence: approval request, evidence package, decision outcomes

actions.action: Evaluate G2 and request the transition
actions.evidence: imported approval re-verified against current content
actions.output: G2 PASS for the scope; REQUIREMENTS_APPROVED
actions.verified_by: workflow gate --gate G2; workflow advance --to REQUIREMENTS_APPROVED
